item.title: Decision Asset: Should I build an AI startup in Tokyo or continue employment?
item.body:
Decision support for: Should I build an AI startup in Tokyo or continue employment? 4 evidence claim(s); 2 human-choosable options (no automatic recommendation). researchArtifactId: ffb7bb4038fa36278e24919f94b50088@1.0.0

question: Should I build an AI startup in Tokyo or continue employment?
asset_id: da-e9d1bf6de513
execution_package_task_id: TA-SHOULD-I-BUILD-AN-AI-STA

## Claims
### claim-000
evidenceId: live-github-2

Time-series forecasting in labor, goods and services, and financial markets of Japan using ARIMA methods. Founding conditions in the target market influence whether a build-first path is viable now. Affects whether timing favors acting now versus deferring.
### claim-001
evidenceId: live-github-3

Spark is a prototype navigation app that helps drivers find available parking spaces using AI-powered predictions. Founding conditions in the target market influence whether a build-first path is viable now. Affects whether timing favors acting now versus deferring.
### claim-002
evidenceId: live-github-5

AI exposure analysis of Japanese job market (~556 occupations). Founding conditions in the target market influence whether a build-first path is viable now. Affects whether timing favors acting now versus deferring.
### claim-003
evidenceId: live-github-7

UI/UX Portfolio resources and case studies for Japan job market - カナダ留学経験を活かした日本向けポートフォリオ資料. Founding conditions in the target market influence whether a build-first path is viable now. Affects whether timing favors acting now versus deferring.

## Options (human chooses — no automatic recommendation)
### opt-pursue-build: Create Tokyo AI startup decision knowledge recording a build-now path versus employment baseline.
supporting_evidence: live-github-2, live-github-3, live-github-5, live-github-7
advantages: Evidence supports exploration: Time-series forecasting in labor, goods and services, and financial markets of Japan using ARIMA methods. Founding condi; Solo-founder path can stay small until distribution is proven; Tokyo timing may capture local AI adoption momentum
risks: Market may already be crowded in AI tooling; Distribution and customer acquisition remain unproven; Capital and attention risk if validation is skipped
unknowns: Who pays first, and for what concrete job-to-be-done?; Regulatory / data constraints for the chosen niche; Personal runway vs time-to-first-revenue
### opt-validate-first: Create Tokyo AI startup decision knowledge recording continue-employment / validate-first before full build.
supporting_evidence: live-github-2, live-github-3, live-github-5, live-github-7
advantages: Reduces irreversible commitment while learning demand; Keeps optionality if evidence quality is still uneven; Can pressure-test signals such as: Spark is a prototype navigation app that helps drivers find available parking spaces using AI-powered predictions. Found
risks: Opportunity window may narrow while validating; Part-time validation can dilute focus
unknowns: How long validation should run before a go/no-go; Whether consulting demand maps to a product wedge
